task.title: Deploy HealthKit formatting fix and audit Workout canary readiness

result.summary: Part 1: the reviewed Evidence formatting fix (4b362591) is deployed with the Founder's chat authorization -- fast-forward push, apps update --spec (only PHYSIQUEOS_GIT_SHA/BUILD_ID changed), force-rebuild after the update reused the old commit. Deployment d4754b09 ACTIVE, source_commit_hash 4b362591, health 200/200, runtime label corrected on web+worker (it had been stale at 924d5e55 since the previous deploy -- found and fixed here). Zero-write proven: Sep 22 canonical acceptance audit before/after shows identical policy, canonical-day revisions, observation states, strategic counts, all 26 strategic digests and migration count. Part 2: read-only Workout canary readiness for Sep 22 is GREEN -- code audit passes every flag with file:line evidence, and the production Workout audit shows policy OFF, 0 workout observations, 0 canonical workouts/links/claims, 1 Logger strength session, 0 ambiguous auto-links, 0 strategic leakage. Nothing activated; Founder not asked to sync. Exact bounded policy values, dry-run/zero-write checks, Founder action and post-sync audit are specified, not executed.

tests.summary: Minimal deploy revalidation at 4b362591 before acting: formatting regression tests 9/9, phase3 282/283 (the one failure is the pre-existing gitignored private/founder/runtime-store.json fixture), worktree clean; candidate confirmed to be exactly the three independently reviewed commits with no drift and no db/migration files. No Native change; Native untouched at 1c57556f.

review.summary: Deployed candidate carries the two adversarial review passes from the prior task (all findings fixed, final re-audit clean). Part 2 used a fresh-context read-only code audit in an isolated worktree (Server at ccff693b, Native at 1c57556f), every claim cited file:line; overall GREEN with one operational precondition: activate the Sep 22 workout policy BEFORE the Founder taps the control, or the day's workouts are stored raw and never reconsidered.

zero_write_audit.summary: Before/after Sep 22 canonical acceptance audits (REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, explicit ROLLBACK, --no-values): policy, canonical-day revisions (activity 16, nutrition 2), observation-state histogram, strategic counts (all 0), all 26 strategic digests and migrations (14) identical. Workout audit under the true SHA: policy OFF, 0 observations, 0 canonical workouts, 0 links, 0 claims, oneToOneIntegrity all zero, ambiguousAutoLinked 0, 1 Logger strength session. No HealthKit data mutated to test formatting. No schema change. Workout policy not activated. Spec secrets are DigitalOcean-encrypted values and were never written into any handoff.

decisions_required: Founder: when convenient, open the Activity and Nutrition Evidence Reports on Build 53 and confirm the headline/subheadline/Activity Areas strings now match the cards (e.g. '2406 calories', '782 active cal / 42 min'). No reinstall needed; it is a Server change.

Founder/agent: authorize the next slice -- exact-date Sep 22 Workout canary activation (policy-kind workout, effective 2026-09-22, end 2026-09-22, quarantined, no backfill, no auto-confirm) with the dry-run/zero-write sequence in the report, followed by the single 'Sync workouts for this day' tap. Activation must precede the tap.

Process: future Server deploys must include the apps update --spec step that bumps PHYSIQUEOS_GIT_SHA/BUILD_ID; a force-rebuild alone leaves the runtime label stale and the audit identity gate refusing.
unexpected_findings: The previous deploy (0bdc1748, ccff693b) had left PHYSIQUEOS_GIT_SHA/BUILD_ID at 924d5e55, so production self-identified as the wrong commit and the zero-write audits' RUNTIME_SHA_MISMATCH gate refused under the true SHA. Corrected by this deploy; the gate was not bypassed.
The 'env-only spec update reuses the old commit' gotcha reproduced exactly (deployment 6c997fe9 built ccff693b); force-rebuild d4754b09 superseded it with 4b362591.
Build 53 emits no sourceRevision for workouts, so a re-query producing different aggregates for the same HKWorkout UUID is refused (409) rather than applied -- fail-closed, not blocking the canary.
backlog: Sep 22 Workout canary activation + single tap + post-sync audit (next authorized slice; fully specified in the report).
Add the spec env bump to the documented deploy checklist so the runtime label cannot drift again.
Workout sourceRevision on Native so revised HKWorkout aggregates can be applied rather than refused (post-canary).
Training raw-double sites (HealthKit HKWorkout doubles) and Native non-HealthKit raw-double sites -- unchanged, on the existing backlog.
recommended_next_step: Founder: visually confirm the Evidence headlines on Build 53, then authorize the Sep 22 Workout canary activation slice (activate policy for exactly 2026-09-22 via dry-run then apply, re-audit, then tap 'Sync workouts for this day' once).
